summary: The README discovery/configuration-precedence section is inaccurate against the implemented runtime reconciliation. It states that discovered instances are appended to any configured inventory and that a configured id wins over a discovered instance with the same id. In the running app, App.Start launches discoveryLoop every 5s and syncDiscoveredInstances rebuilds the inventory solely from current discovery output: a same-id configured instance is replaced by the discovered definition, and any configured instance not present in discovery output (for example a remote SSH instance) is removed. An overlay test (TestSyncDiscoveredReconcilesConfiguredInventory) confirmed a configured 'one' was replaced by discovered 'one' and a configured remote instance was dropped. Documentation must either describe this replacement/reconciliation semantics accurately or the discovery loop must preserve configured instances; as written it misleads operators about precedence and persistence.
